correctness.rationale: For one season, column substochasticity bounds spectral radius by max diagonal reproduction at d=0. In two seasons, the positive diagonal symmetrizer Q commutes with D_t and replaces C by symmetric B; A(d)=D2^{1/2}((1-d)I+dB)D1^{1/2} yields sqrt(rho(M(d)D2M(d)D1))=||A(d)||_2, and convexity gives endpoint dominance for all dimension and all positive D_t. For two patches with opposite environments, endpoint radii ab and c²a² switch at c=sqrt(b/a); strict inequality for interior d follows from unequal endpoint norms or the noncollinear singular-vector image at the tied endpoints. At three seasons, the exact swap example yields endpoint rho 4, interior rho 25/4. Independent exact symbolic monodromy calculations and symmetric stochastic 3x3 norm-convexity checks passed. This is asymptotic linear growth, not an ESS theorem.
